name: classifier
instructions: Classify this banking support customer message into exactly one of the 77 intents. Pay close attention to the exact action or problem being reported by the customer.

criteria.atm_support: ATM issues; e.g., 'Can I make a withdraw at an ATM?', 'Where are the ATMs that I can use Mastercard?'
criteria.automatic_top_up: Automatic top-up of account; e.g., 'Is auto top up available?', 'What is the limit for auto top-up?'
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Balance not updated after receiving a bank transfer; e.g., 'Why isn't the transfer to my account showing up?'
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Balance not updated after depositing cash or cheque; e.g., 'I sent you a cheque and nothing has happened yet'
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot transfer to a recipient because they're blocked; e.g., 'I need to transfer to my account and can't'
criteria.cancel_transfer: Stopping or reversing a transfer already sent; e.g., 'I want to revert this morning's transaction'
criteria.card_arrival: When will the ordered card arrive; e.g., 'Is there a way to track the delivery of my card?'
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long until card arrives; e.g., 'How long will it take my card to get here?'
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Fee for a card purchase; e.g., 'Why was I charged extra using my card?'
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Unexpected card charge; e.g., 'Why is this payment on my app', 'I didn't make a payment that shows in my app'
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate on card purchase
criteria.declined_transfer: Transfer rejected; e.g., 'Why can I not make a transfer?'
criteria.exchange_rate: Exchange rate questions; e.g., 'When I was abroad, the exchange rate was wrong'
criteria.failed_transfer: Transfer failed; e.g., 'I'm not sure if my pop-up went through', 'I need my mortgage to go through. However, every time I check I get an error message'
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Supported currencies; e.g., 'Do you hold money and if so, what currencies do you accept?'
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card; e.g., 'I am yet to receive my pin', 'I have not received my pin yet'
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost/stolen; e.g., 'Can you help me retrieve my card?'
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering physical card; e.g., 'Do you ship your cards anywhere?'
criteria.pending_card_payment: Card payment in progress; e.g., 'When will my payment go through?'
criteria.pending_top_up: Top-up in progress; e.g., 'Why can't I see my funds after I topped up?'
criteria.pending_transfer: Transfer in progress; e.g., 'How much longer do I have to wait until my transaction is complete?'
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving a transfer; e.g., 'Can this app take my salary?', 'What are the steps for getting money from a friend?'
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Refund not received yet; e.g., 'I contacted a seller about a refund last week but he still hasn't returned my money'
criteria.request_refund: Requesting a refund; e.g., 'How long does it take to get a refund on something I bought?'
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: Card payment reversed; e.g., 'I bought something and already paid for it but now I don't see it'
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards/currencies accepted; e.g., 'What cards do you accept to top up my account?'
criteria.terminate_account: Closing account; e.g., 'Can you delete the account?'
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for bank transfer top-up; e.g., 'I want to do a swift transfer'
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for card top-up; e.g., 'What is the fee for topping up by card?'
criteria.top_up_failed: Top-up failed; e.g., 'The money disappeared when I tried to use my card to top up'
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Same charge appears twice; e.g., 'I need a transaction reversed from my account'
criteria.transfer_into_account: Receiving transfer; e.g., 'Account topping up bank transfers to my account'
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Confirming money source; e.g., 'How can I find out where the funds are coming from?'
criteria.why_verify_identity: Understanding why verification needed; e.g., 'Do i have to verify who I am?'
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate on cash withdrawal; e.g., 'I wasn't applied the correct exchange rate when getting cash'
